sentences.text: Ct No.34 Raju Nandi & Anr vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr

In The High Court At Calcutta 23-03-2023 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction Subha Crr
1286 of 2021 Item no.36 Ct no.34 Raju Nandi & Anr.
-versus-
The State of West Bengal & Anr.
Mr. Ayan Bhattacharyya Ms. Ritu Das ....for the petitioners.
Mr. Prasun Kumar Datta Mr. Santanu Deb Roy ....for the STate.

Record of this revisional application reflects that the subject matter relates to an order dated 22nd March, 2021 in respect of Domjur Police Station Case No. 1108 of 2014 dated October 25, 2014 under Sections 498A/302/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Sections 3 and 4 of the D. P. Act.
The issue relates to further cross-examination of some of the witnesses which was turned down by the learned Additional District & Sessions Judge, 3rd Fast Track Court, Howarh.

entities.text: Domjur Police Station Case No. 1108 of 2014
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Substantial time has passed since the present revisional application was admitted and the evidence of the case was in progress.
At least the record reflects that almost nine witnesses were already examined.
Accordingly, learned advocate for the State is directed to submit a progress report on the next date fixed for hearing particularly the stage at which the sessions trial is in progress.
List this revisional application on 28th March, 2023 when the matter would appear under the same heading.

All concerned parties are to act in terms of a copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this court.
[Tirthankar Ghosh, J]
